Selecting Body.
4. Today, the matter is listed on 
amendment application (IA/2/2026), 
whereby, petitioners want to incorporate 
certain amendment in Ground ‘A’ and 
prayer (i) of the writ petition, as mentioned 
in Para 4 of the amendment application.
5. There is no objection from the side of 
respondents for the proposed amendment.
6. Accordingly, amendment application 
(IA/2/2026) is allowed.
7. Let the necessary amendment be 
incorporated by supplying the amended 
memo of writ petition within a week.
8. Put up on 21.09.2026.
